title: The Silent Eruption of Lake Nyos
hook: How could a peaceful lake suddenly kill over a thousand people?
script: How could a peaceful lake suddenly kill over a thousand people? In 1986, Lake Nyos in Cameroon erupted without warning. This seemingly calm body of water released 1.2 cubic kilometers of carbon dioxide overnight. The gas, heavier than air, suffocated more than 1,700 people in their sleep. Locals had no chance to escape the invisible blanket of death. Scientists still debate what triggered this disaster, but the consequences were catastrophic. To prevent another tragedy, engineers now ventilate the lake continuously. This industrial effort turns a potential disaster into a managed resource.
